body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{adapt}}\)
body.construction: On the binary-treatment inference submodel \(\mathcal A=\{d,e\}\), begin with \(\mathcal H_n\), stratify candidate laws by the LP-computed slack \(\tau_{a,b}^r\), and invert a studentized test of the primitive mass vector on each slack stratum; the data-dependent critical value and final region are to be derived
